summary: Prudential plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing the currency conversion rates for its 2025 second interim dividend. The cash dividend is 18.89 US cents per share, with US dollar conversion rates of 0.737967 GBP/USD and 7.837030 HKD/USD for UK and Hong Kong shareholders, respectively. The scrip dividend alternative offers new shares on the Hong Kong line. Payment for cash elections is scheduled for 13 May 2026. This is a routine dividend announcement with no special-situation event, such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring. The filing is an ordinary periodic report, not triggering any special-situation category.
